title: SQL for QA
tagline: Read, verify, and prepare data — the SQL a tester needs against the sample HRMS schema.
who: QA engineers who already click through UIs and hit APIs and need to prove what the database actually stored.
outcomes: Write SELECT/JOIN/GROUP BY queries that independently recompute what the HRMS UI and API claim
Find duplicates, orphans, and migration defects with reusable sanity-check queries
Seed and clean tagged test data safely, and wire SQL assertions into Playwright, pytest, Cypress, and CI
